# Precise Hunter (`features:ranger-precise-hunter`)
**Class:** [Ranger](../classes/ranger.md) | **Level:** [Ranger 17](../levels/ranger-17.md)

You have Advantage on attack rolls against the creature currently marked by your Hunter's Mark.
